**Before you request!**
To ensure a good fit, please create and print a test part with the hole diameter you are requesting. You can do this directly in your slicer by adding a block and adding a negative volume modifier to it with your hole size. 

**What hole diameter would you like to request?**
Ex. 6.5mm
